Use the real Mailbox new/open_worker/admit/reserve/copied chain; admit already constructs the private Call, so no insertion or Call constructor API is authorized.
Row 18 uses mismatched-PID Ok(None), pre-RET publish Ok(false), ordinary return_value, then wake-None publish Ok(true) with one release.

Rows 20 and 27 complete mode-3 recovery at exactly t+2000000000 before their respective post-RET or post-publication cancellation conclusions; mode-2 notification failure is separate and follows publication/release.
Rows 25 and 26 use serialized fresh-process cancel-before-RET and RET-before-precommit-cancel cases and never reenter one mutable Mailbox or owner lock.
Stages 0, 1, 6 and 255 and stage-3 commits 0 or 2 publish -11 and latch -71; stages 2, 4 and 5 publish -11 with invalid zero; hold baselines follow successful preparation.
The second-CAS one-shot test hook receives only the live AtomicU64 reference inside Err(2), retains no reference, forces the second CAS mismatch and preserves the written prefix.
The test-owned generic backing may use an aligned 56-byte allocation with 8-byte guards around the 40-byte response, deferred deallocation and distinct released versus unfinished Drop ledger events.
The stager creates 161 files per mode plus the root and four subdirectories; fresh parent/mode creation authority, every evidence path and both inverse-restoration stages must be named explicitly.

blocking_native_ownership_gap.finding: A runner-owned allocation plus copied stability_observer::Claim metadata cannot prove native SyscallResponse ownership. Memory::new requires retained OS-generation, extent and BootStorage authority, and release consumes the private production ledger entry.
blocking_native_ownership_gap.required: Specify and independently review a production-owned Memory/BootStorage/OS-generation/extent construction and lifetime path with an expanded source/write boundary before claiming the native ownership contract.

disposition: A separately labelled generic actual-method prerequisite may be drafted from the resolved design, but it cannot replace or satisfy native ownership acceptance. Do not issue another complete implementation packet until the production-owned backing mechanism is specified and reviewed.
